brief:
Raji Sourani, director of the Palestinian Centre for Human Rights, received the International Hrant Dink Award on September 15, 2026, at a ceremony in Istanbul. The award recognized his decades of human rights advocacy in the Occupied Palestinian Territory.

The ceremony took place at the Harbiye Muhsin Ertuğrul Stage in Turkey and drew attendance from multiple participants, according to the Palestinian Centre for Human Rights.
